purpose: Per CEO R295 P0: 'Change every COMMERCIALIZED label to COMMERCIAL_FRAMED unless the candidate has an actual buyer transaction or equivalent external commercial evidence. This is exactly the semantic promotion problem the constitution is supposed to prevent.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXVIII (no silent semantic promotion). Article X (honest disclosure). Article XXV (unknown must remain unknown).
the_problem: R294 labeled P-06, P-08, P-09, P-10, P-12, P-13, P-15 as 'COMMERCIALIZED' despite having: no engineering design, no prototype, no test protocol, no known evidence, no buyer evaluation, no provenance, no buyer WTP, zero transactions. A candidate with a mechanism, a price hypothesis and a buyer map is NOT 'commercialized.' It is 'commercially framed.' This is semantic inflation.

state_transition_rules.DISCOVERED → COMMERCIAL_FRAMED: Requires: mechanism defined + market identified + buyer list + price target + next experiment defined. Does NOT require: any technical evidence or buyer contact.
state_transition_rules.COMMERCIAL_FRAMED → TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIE: Requires: engineering design started + first falsification test defined + some computational or theoretical evidence. Does NOT require: physical validation or buyer contact.
state_transition_rules.TECHNICALLY_SPECIFIED → VALIDATION_READY: Requires: complete engineering design + frozen test protocol + pre-registered acceptance criteria + provenance manifest. Does NOT require: physical validation passed or buyer contact.
state_transition_rules.VALIDATION_READY → INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDAT: Requires: external party (lab, buyer, CRO) has run the test protocol and confirmed or refuted results. Requires: independent evidence record.
state_transition_rules.INDEPENDENTLY_VALIDATED → ECONOMICALLY_P: Requires: buyer has indicated willingness-to-pay (Tier 3 economics filled with BUYER_EVIDENCE provenance). Does NOT require: actual offer or transaction.
state_transition_rules.ECONOMICALLY_PROVEN → BUYER_READY: Requires: buyer has made actual offer (Tier 4 economics). Does NOT require: completed transaction.
state_transition_rules.BUYER_READY → PILOT: Requires: buyer is actively evaluating the package (pilot study, technical evaluation engagement).
state_transition_rules.PILOT → TRANSACTION: Requires: buyer has paid (Tier 5 economics filled). Signed PO or equivalent.
state_transition_rules.anti_inflation_rule: A state can NEVER be skipped. A candidate with no evidence cannot be VALIDATION_READY. A candidate with no buyer contact cannot be ECONOMICALLY_PROVEN. Article XXVIII.

honest_summary: The portfolio has 15 commercially framed technology candidates. 1 is validation-ready (P-01). 1 is technically specified (P-04). 7 are commercially framed (mechanism + market + buyers + price target + next experiment defined, but NO evidence yet). 6 are discovered (mechanism defined, next experiment not yet started). 0 are independently validated. 0 are economically proven. 0 are buyer-ready. 0 are in pilot. 0 transactions. This is honest.
